title: Matrix invariance under reduction
statement: For natural numbers $p,m$ and a list $R$ of lists of natural numbers, the $m\times m$ matrix over $\mathbb Z/p\mathbb Z$ obtained from $R$ is unchanged if every entry of $R$ is first reduced modulo $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a list of lists of natural numbers
